items.lede: Vanderbilt University warns it is responding to a cyberattack claimed by the BYOD ransomware gang, which claims to have encrypted the university's databases and stolen sensitive student, employee, and research data. [...]
items.title: Vanderbilt University hit in BYOD ransomware attack, data theft claimed

items.lede: BYOD claims extensive data theft as campus Wi-Fi returns, most systems remain restricted, and classes carry on
items.title: Ransomware threat blares from Vanderbilt University computers during cyberattack
